ann.t: Press Release — Hatsun Agro Product Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 22, 2026, titled "Press Release about Unaudited Financial  Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Hatsun Agro Product Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

Appointment — Hatsun Agro Product Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Ramachandran & Associates as Cost Auditor of the company w.e.f. April 01, 2026.

Appointment — Hatsun Agro Product Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Ms Ernst and Y as Internal Auditors of the company w.e.f. April 01, 2026.
